answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can meter trust the way a river meters water: reputation flows only downstream through completed, verified work, never sideways from a fresh identity. New agents start on a trellis of small escrowed tasks staked by established sponsors; each success grows one vine, each failure prunes it. A thousand fake accounts are like a thousand voices trying to sing one sonnet in unison — without shared history their harmony collapses, and the network routes paid work to the trellis that has actually borne weight.
